members.name: fold
members.doc:
Request structure prediction with Protenix.

Parameters
----------
sequences : FoldInput | MSAFuture
    Complexes to fold, or a lone complex/protein/sequence. `Protein` objects must be tagged with an `msa`, which can be a `Protein.single_sequence_mode` for single sequence mode. Alternatively, supply an `MSAFuture` to use all query sequences as a multimer.
diffusion_samples: int
    Number of diffusion samples to use
num_recycles : int
    Number of recycling steps to use
num_steps : int
    Number of sampling steps to use
templates: list[Protein | Complex | Template] | None = None
    List of templates to use for structure prediction.
seed : int | None
    Seed for the prediction, from 0 to 2**31 - 1. None draws a new
    seed for each call, so every call is a fresh prediction; the job's
    ``metadata.args["seed"]`` records it. Folding the same input with
    the same seed returns the same structures.

Returns
-------
FoldResultFuture
    Future for the folding results.

members.name: fold
members.doc:
Request structure prediction with Boltz-2 model.

Parameters
----------
sequences : FoldInput | MSAFuture
    Complexes to fold, or a lone complex/protein/sequence. `Protein` objects must be tagged with an `msa`, which can be a `Protein.single_sequence_mode` for single sequence mode. Alternatively, supply an `MSAFuture` to use all query sequences as a multimer.
diffusion_samples: int
    Number of diffusion samples to use
num_recycles : int
    Number of recycling steps to use
num_steps : int
    Number of sampling steps to use
step_scale : float
    Scaling factor for diffusion steps.
use_potentials: bool = False.
    Whether or not to use potentials.
constraints : list[dict] | None = None
    List of constraints.
templates: list[Protein | Complex | Template] | None = None
    List of templates to use for structure prediction.
properties: list[dict] | None = None
    List of additional properties to predict. Should match the `BoltzProperties`
method: str | None
    The experimental method or supervision source used for the prediction. Defults to None.
    Supported values (case-insensitive) include:
    'MD', 'X-RAY DIFFRACTION', 'ELECTRON MICROSCOPY', 'SOLUTION NMR',
    'SOLID-STATE NMR', 'NEUTRON DIFFRACTION', 'ELECTRON CRYSTALLOGRAPHY',
    'FIBER DIFFRACTION', 'POWDER DIFFRACTION', 'INFRARED SPECTROSCOPY',
    'FLUORESCENCE TRANSFER', 'EPR', 'THEORETICAL MODEL',
    'SOLUTION SCATTERING', 'OTHER', 'AFDB', 'BOLTZ-1'.
    View the documentation on Boltz for upstream details.
seed : int | None
    Seed for the prediction, from 0 to 2**31 - 1. None draws a new
    seed for each call, so every call is a fresh prediction; the job's
    ``metadata.args["seed"]`` records it. Folding the same input with
    the same seed returns the same structures.

Returns
-------
FoldResultFuture
     Future for the folding result.

members.name: get_item
members.doc:
Get fold results for one unit of the fold job.

Parameters
----------
k : int
    Zero-based index of the unit, as returned by ``__keys__``.
key : str or None, optional
    Which result to fetch. ``None`` returns the predicted structure.
    Otherwise one of ``"pae"``, ``"pde"``, ``"plddt"``, ``"ptm"``,
    ``"ipae"``, ``"confidence"``, ``"affinity"``, ``"score"`` or
    ``"metrics"``. Availability varies by model.

Returns

entries.name: OpenDDEModel
entries.doc:
Class providing inference endpoints for OpenDDE structure prediction.

OpenDDE folds protein, DNA, RNA, ligand and ion entities into a single
all-atom complex, optionally conditioned on an MSA per protein chain.

parsed.text:
Class providing inference endpoints for OpenDDE structure prediction.

OpenDDE folds protein, DNA, RNA, ligand and ion entities into a single
all-atom complex, optionally conditioned on an MSA per protein chain.

members.name: fold
members.doc:
Request structure prediction with OpenDDE.

Parameters
----------
sequences : FoldInput | MSAFuture
    List of complexes to fold. `Protein` objects must be tagged with an
    `msa`, which can be `Protein.single_sequence_mode` to fold without
    one. Alternatively, supply an `MSAFuture` to use all its query
    sequences as a multimer.
diffusion_samples : int
    Number of diffusion samples to generate per prediction.
num_recycles : int
    Number of recycling iterations to run.
num_steps : int
    Number of diffusion sampling steps.
seed : int | None
    Seed for the diffusion sampling, from 0 to 2**32 - 1. None draws a
    new seed for each call, so every call is a fresh prediction; the
    job's ``metadata.args["seed"]`` records it. Input preparation,
    ligand conformers included, is not seeded, so folding the same
    input with the same seed can still give different structures,
    especially for complexes with a ligand.

Returns
-------
FoldResultFuture
    Future for the folding results.

    Number of recycling iterations used.
disorder : float
    Disorder score (currently always 0.0).
chain_ptm : list[float]
    Per-chain pTM scores, indexed by chain.
chain_iptm : list[float]
    Per-chain ipTM scores.
chain_plddt : list[float]
    Per-chain mean pLDDT scores.
chain_gpde : list[float]
    Per-chain global PDE scores.
chain_pair_iptm : list[list[float]]
    Chain-pair ipTM matrix.
chain_pair_iptm_global : list[list[float]]
    Chain-pair ipTM matrix with ligand-aware weighting.
chain_pair_gpde : list[list[float]]
    Chain-pair global PDE matrix.
chain_pair_plddt : list[list[float]]
    Chain-pair mean pLDDT matrix.

Notes
-----
OpenDDE emits three further scores - ``pb_ranking_score``,
``has_vdw_pl_clash`` and ``pb_ranking_score_vdw_penalized`` - only when a
prediction targets a specific binder chain. This API never requests that, so
they are not declared here; ``extra = "allow"`` passes them through should
that change.
